reflection.en: Amidst escalating tensions and diplomatic efforts, the call to pursue peace remains vital. Even when circumstances are complex and actions by others provoke reactions, the commitment to live peaceably, as far as it depends on us, is a profound challenge. May these talks be guided by a spirit that seeks genuine resolution and de-escalation.
reflection.zh: 在紧张局势升级和外交努力并存之际，追求和平的呼召至关重要。即使环境复杂，他人的行动引发反弹，我们仍要尽力与众人和睦相处，这是一项深刻的挑战。愿这些会谈能以寻求真正解决和缓和局势的精神为指导。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Former Olympian denies vandalising Washington Reflecting Pool after arrest
title.zh: 前奥运选手被捕后否认破坏华盛顿倒影池

summary.en: Davey Hearn says he was simply touching the new paint at the site out of curiosity and did not remove or alter it.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A former US Olympian arrested for allegedly vandalising the Reflecting Pool in Washington DC is denying he did anything wrong.

David "Davey" Hearn, 67, was detained by the pool's edge on Friday as he was finishing a long bike ride.

Hearn told BBC News that he had removed his cycling glove to simply touch a long strip of rubbery material which appeared to have "delaminated" from the bottom of the pool, when he was stopped by US Park Police and National Guard troops.

The champion canoeist is now facing a misdemeanour charge of destruction of government property.

The Reflecting Pool has just undergone a multi-million dollar resealing and painting project, but already the paint appears to be peeling off.

President Donald Trump has championed the pool's makeover as part of his bid to beautify the US capital ahead of America's 250th birthday celebrations.

The historic Reflecting Pool, stretching 2,030ft (619m) between the Lincoln Memorial and the Washington Monument, has long been beset by leaks, structural deterioration, faulty pipes, algae growth and bird droppings.

But despite the refurbishment, which cost an estimated $13m (£9.8m), the pool has continued to be plagued by algae and more recently the paint problems, which have seen media and park visitors document pieces of the new blue paint peeling off from the bottom of the pool.

Trump said in a post on Truth Social on Saturday that US Park Police had "arrested multiple individuals for vandalizing our Nations magnificent Reflecting Pool".

"Who would do such a thing? These are very serious crimes having to do with the destruction of National Monuments," he continued, adding that "work will begin immediately on its repair".

Hearn told BBC News on Saturday that he "didn't destroy, rip, tear, peel, or remove any part" of the paint.

"It wasn't affected. It was the same before I got there as when I walked away from it."

A video posted to social media of Hearn's arrest shows him standing near a water-pumping hose that is lying across a footpath and speaking to a woman, before walking away and picking up his bike.

He is then approached by two National Guard troops, and the video shows that he was later placed in handcuffs, with US Park Police also standing around.

The post includes a suggestion that he had grabbed the hose from one of the park workers, though Hearn denied this when speaking with the Washington Post and said it was possible that his bike tyre had moved it.

Hearn competed three times in the Olympics in the slalom canoe category, and won two world championships for the sport.

He has also designed boats, paddles and other waterproof products, and said he was curious about what materials had been used to paint the pool.

The 67-year-old said he only touched the material briefly...
body.zh: 一名因涉嫌破坏华盛顿特区倒影池而被捕的前美国奥运选手否认自己做错了任何事。 67 岁的大卫·“戴维”·赫恩 (David Hearn) 周五在完成长途自行车骑行后被困在泳池边。 赫恩告诉英国广播公司新闻，当他被美国公园警察和国民警卫队拦住时，他摘下了自行车手套，只是碰了一下似乎从池底“分层”的长条橡胶材料。 这位独木舟冠军现在面临着破坏政府财产的轻罪指控。 倒影池刚刚经历了耗资数百万美元的重新密封和油漆工程，但油漆似乎已经剥落。 唐纳德·特朗普总统在美国 250 岁生日庆祝活动之前支持对游泳池进行改造，作为美化美国首都的一部分。 历史悠久的倒影池位于林肯纪念堂和华盛顿纪念碑之间，绵延 2,030 英尺（619 m），长期以来一直受到泄漏、结构恶化、管道故障、藻类生长和鸟粪的困扰。 尽管翻新工程耗资约 1300 万美元（980 万英镑），但该泳池仍然受到藻类和最近油漆问题的困扰，媒体和公园游客记录了泳池底部新蓝色油漆脱落的碎片。 特朗普周六在《Truth Social》上发帖称，美国公园警察“逮捕了多名破坏我国宏伟倒影池的人”。 “谁会做这样的事情？这些都是与破坏国家纪念碑有关的非常严重的罪行，”他继续说道，并补充说“修复工作将立即开始”。 赫恩周六告诉英国广播公司新闻，他“没有破坏、撕裂、撕裂、剥离或去除油漆的任何部分”。 “它没有受到影响。我到达那里之前和离开那里时都是一样的。” 社交媒体上发布的一段赫恩被捕的视频显示，他站在人行道上的一根抽水软管附近，与一名女子交谈，然后走开并拿起了自行车。 然后两名国民警卫队士兵接近他，视频显示他后来被戴上手铐，美国公园警察也站在周围。 帖子中提到他从一名公园工作人员手中夺走了软管，不过赫恩在接受《华盛顿邮报》采访时否认了这一点，并表示可能是他的自行车轮胎移动了软管。 赫恩曾三度参加奥运会皮划艇激流回旋项目，并两次赢得这项运动的世界冠军。 他还设计了船只、桨和其他防水产品，并表示他很好奇游泳池是用什么材料绘制的。 这位 67 岁的老人说他只是简单地接触过这些材料......

title.en: US-Iran talks to begin in Switzerland as Tehran says it closed Strait of Hormuz
title.zh: 伊朗称因以色列袭击黎巴嫩而关闭霍尔木兹海峡

summary.en: Iran claimed to have closed the Strait of Hormuz following Israeli attacks on Lebanon, a claim disputed by the US military. This development occurs just before scheduled talks between the US and Iran in Switzerland.
summary.zh: 伊朗声称因以色列袭击黎巴嫩而关闭霍尔木兹海峡，但美国军方对此说法提出异议。这一事件发生在美国与伊朗在瑞士举行会谈之前。

body.en:
Direct talks between the US and Iran are set to begin in Switzerland despite the Iranian military saying it has closed the Strait of Hormuz again over Israel's attacks on southern Lebanon.

Iran also cited a breach of its agreement with the US to end the war as a reason for the closure. However, the US military has said "traffic continues to flow" in the strait.

US Vice-President JD Vance arrived in Switzerland early on Sunday morning. The new round of negotiations is expected to start later in the day.

An Iranian delegation including parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi arrived late on Saturday.

Officials from the US and Iran will be joined at the talks by Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and the head of the country's armed forces, Field Marshal Asim Munir.

Pakistan has acted as a mediator throughout the war , and hosted a previous round of negotiations between the US and Iran.

"Pakistan will continue to support the implementation of the understandings between Iran and the United States," the Pakistan Ministry of Foreign Affairs said in a statement ahead of the talks.

Vance said he hoped to make progress "on the nuclear issue" and on the "Lebanon ceasefire issue".

Speaking to the press before he boarded his flight, he was asked about clashes between Israel and Hezbollah and Israeli air strikes in southern Lebanon and said: "Things are actually getting better there, and things are slowing down a little bit."

"It's going to be something we're just going to have to continuously manage to ensure that Israel and Lebanon are both safe and secure. That's fundamentally the goal of this, to make the whole region safe and secure," he said.

Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei said his country would be "demanding that the other side fulfil its commitments".

Earlier this week the US and Iranian presidents signed an initial agreement aiming to end the war, including in Lebanon, with immediate effect. It includes a commitment to further talks to reach a final deal over the next 60 days.

Complicating matters are the ongoing clashes between Israel and Hezbollah, the Iran-backed militia based in the southern suburbs of Lebanon's capital Beirut.

On Saturday, at least 47 people were killed in Lebanon following a series of Israeli air strikes, the country's health ministry has said.

The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said it had struck 80 targets linked to Hezbollah and killed "dozens" of its members.

Israel and Hezbollah have continued to exchange fire since the deal was announced between the US and Iran, but on Friday afternoon an immediate ceasefire between the two was confirmed.

title.en: UN warns of 'imminent risk of mass atrocities' in Sudan
title.zh: 联合国警告苏丹存在“大规模暴行迫在眉睫的风险”

summary.en: The UN Security Council has issued a warning about the "imminent risk of mass atrocities" in Sudan, stating that aid organizations are preparing for the displacement of a large number of people from a southern region of the country.
summary.zh: 联合国安理会警告苏丹存在“大规模暴行迫在眉睫的风险”，并表示援助机构正在为该国南部地区大量民众的迁徙做准备。

body.en:
The United Nations Security Council said Saturday it is concerned over the "imminent risk of mass atrocities" in Sudan as it called on paramilitary forces encircling El-Obeid to back down.

The majority-Muslim southern city, in the Kordofan region, has been under siege for several months by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), which has been at war with the regular army since April 2023.

"The members of the Security Council expressed concern at the imminent risk of mass atrocities and demanded the RSF immediately halt its assault on El-Obeid," the Security Council said in a statement.

"Council members called on the parties to the conflict to immediately halt the fighting."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The UN has voiced fears that there could be a repeat of the atrocities committed during the October 2025 assault on the city of El-Fasher, which it said bore "hallmarks of genocide."

The UN said Friday that Pekka Haavisto, the secretary-general's special envoy for Sudan, had called rebel paramilitary forces chief Mohamed Hamdan Daglo to urge him not to attack El-Obeid.

Haavisto "underscored the need to urgently de-escalate the situation in El-Obeid and avoid any actions that may further worsen the already dire humanitarian situation and put civilian lives further at risk," said Stephane Dujarric, spokesman for UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres.

The official said aid workers were "preparing for the potential movements of large numbers of people" fleeing the city, and that "our humanitarian colleagues are doing the responsible thing, which is getting ready for the worst while hoping for the best."

Dujarric said Haavisto was also talking to countries with influence over the warring parties to encourage dialogue and prevent the assault.

The conflict in Sudan has killed tens of thousands of people and forced more than 11 million from their homes, creating what the UN describes as the world's largest displacement and hunger crises.

title.en: 'History not positive': Albanese warns of leaders spill amid Keir Starmer resignation reports
title.zh: “历史并不乐观”：阿尔巴尼斯就基尔·斯塔默辞职传闻警告领导人更迭

body.en:
Australia's Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has warned against a leadership change in the United Kingdom amid reports his British Labour counterpart Keir Starmer could be about to resign.

Britain's Observer newspaper is reporting Starmer is expected to resign on Monday and set out a timetable for his departure.

The Observer report, which did not name its sources, said Starmer had reached the conclusion that his position was no longer tenable after speaking to cabinet ministers, advisers, donors and trade union leaders.

However, a government source said Starmer remained focused on getting on with the job of governing.

Asked about the potential change by Sky News on Sunday morning, Albanese said he will "deal with whoever is elected".

"But I must say that the history of just changing leaders is not a positive one," he said. "I've dealt with already four British prime ministers since I've been elected as prime minister."

Speculation of Starmer's retirement has been building for months and has accelerated since Friday, when his rival Andy Burnham won more than 50 per cent of the vote in the Makerfield byelection, officially allowing him to now launch a formal leadership challenge.

Burnham, the 56-year-old mayor of Greater Manchester, is widely seen as Starmer's most likely successor, whether through a negotiated transfer of power or a formal leadership contest.

He used his victory speech to promise a new path for the United Kingdom, rather than launching an immediate formal challenge.

Starmer said on Friday he would fight any challenge to his leadership and urged Labour not to tear itself apart with infighting.

Starmer led the centre-left Labour party to a landslide election win in 2024, but became deeply unpopular after a series of scandals, policy U-turns and local election defeats.

More than 100 elected lawmakers in Starmer's party - roughly a quarter of all Labour representatives in the House of Commons - have publicly said they want him to quit or set out a timetable for his exit, according to a Reuters tally.

If he were to quit or be ousted, it would be the United Kingdom's seventh prime minister in just over a decade — the highest turnover in nearly two centuries.

Albanese has previously backed Starmer's leadership, in May saying: "He is a friend of mine, and I hope that Keir Starmer continues to serve as prime minister of the United Kingdom", and warning that the, "revolving door of leaders does not lead to stability".

title.en: Scottish anti-terrorism police investigating alleged anti-muslim attacks

summary.en: Scottish anti-terrorism police are investigating alleged anti-Muslim attacks. These incidents occur amidst increasing anti-immigration sentiment across the UK.

body.en:
Scottish counter-terrorism police are investigating several suspected anti-Muslim attacks in Edinburgh. The alleged attacks — in which five men were wounded — have been condemned by Prime Minister Keir Starmer.

Police Scotland said officers had arrested a 36-year-old white Scottish man and there was "no further threat to the public".

Footage posted online showed a bare-chested man — purportedly the suspect — roaming streets of the Scottish capital with a large weapon.

A police statement said they had received multiple emergency calls late Friday from people reporting "violent attacks including threats, robbery and vandalism across Edinburgh, with five men injured".

The victims — two aged 22, and others aged 24, 27, and 39 — sustained various injuries, said police. Three required hospital treatment, but none of the injuries were life-threatening, the statement added.

Counter-terrorism and other police officers were investigating, the statement added.

"Absolutely appalling," Starmer said on X. "The suspect appears to be motivated by anti-Muslim hatred. I will not tolerate this -- he will face the full force of the law."

Scotland's First Minister John Swinney said he was "deeply concerned", in a post on X.

"There is no place for violence, racism or intolerance in our country," he added.

Both the Scottish Association of Mosques and the anti-Islamophobia non-profit Muslim Engagement and Development (MEND) said several of the victims were Muslims.

MEND noted the alleged footage of the arrested man circulating online also showed him shouting about "protecting the country" from Muslims, accompanied by expletive-filled language.

The organisation urged police to "treat this as what the evidence indicates: Islamophobic, far-right terror".

The mosques association noted: "In recent days we have seen calls for anti-migrant protests circulating online, alongside increasingly aggressive rhetoric directed at minority communities.

"These developments should concern everyone, regardless of faith or background."

The incident comes as tensions are high across the UK over immigration and diversity. There have been claims far-right agitators are fuelling racist sentiment after a number of high-profile incidents.

The Northern Irish capital Belfast experienced two nights of serious disorder last week after a knife attack, allegedly perpetrated by a Sudanese refugee, was captured on camera and went viral online.

title.en: Backstage at Gorillaz' epic, one-off stadium show: 'The vibe is ridiculous'
title.zh: Gorillaz史诗般、独一无二的体育场演出幕后：“气氛太棒了”

summary.en: Damon Albarn, De La Soul, and Moonchild Sannelly were interviewed backstage at Gorillaz' largest-ever show, where the atmosphere was described as "ridiculous."
summary.zh: 达蒙·阿尔巴恩、De La Soul和Moonchild Sannelly在Gorillaz有史以来最大规模的演出后台接受了采访，现场气氛被形容为“不可思议”。

body.en:
It's Friday night at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, and he's in the middle of rehearsals for Gorillaz' first ever stadium show - a multicultural, multimedia pop extravaganza, with more guests than a double-booked Airbnb.

As the band launches into Dirty Harry, the long, pitch-side advertising hoardings light up with a cartoon choir, singing the song's refrain, "all I do is dance".

Apparently taken by surprise, Albarn jumps off the stage to watch, with a broad, toothy grin spreading across his face. Then he spots Argentine rapper Trueno striding across the stadium floor, and rushes over for a hug.

The band play on without their leader - and it takes almost 10 minutes for Albarn to realise he might be needed on stage.

Quite the opposite: Albarn's laid-back vibes set the tone for the whole entourage.

Backstage at Tottenham, there are more than 30 musicians from 15 different countries, and not a scintilla of ego between them.

"The vibe is ridiculous," says South African singer Moonchild Sanelly. "Damon is open, he's cool, he has the humility.

"Everybody whose art he admires, he brings them along for the ride. Even when he's zenned out, I'll go sit next to him, just so we can breathe each other's air."

"It's an eclectic family for sure," says Kara Jackson, a folk singer and poet who's been a regular guest at Gorillaz' recent shows.

"It's kind of like coming from the South, where I'm from in the States. You have cousins, but they're not really your blood cousins - you've just been calling your mum's best friend your aunt for all these years."

Behind the scenes, it's like a United Nations of music. Malian singer Fatoumata Diawara is chatting away in traditional Wassoulou clothes, while Johnny Marr ambles past in an equally traditional Mancunian parka.

American alt-pop heroes Sparks pull up in a black BMW just after 17:00 BST, and pop open the boot to retrieve their stage costumes (Russell has a pink polka-dot suit, Ron is in funeral clothes).

Twenty minutes later, they are on stage rehearsing The Happy Dictator; followed by Shaun Ryder, hamming up his part on the 2005 classic Dare!

Over in the canteen, Syrian and African musicians chow down with Posdnuos from De La Soul and sitar legend Anoushka Shankar. On the menu, honey-glazed lime chicken, roast sea bass, caramelised leek penne and an outrageously moreish passion fruit meringue.

"When we went on the tour with Gorillaz the first time (in 2010), I put on so much weight that, when I came home, I had to get in the gym and get right."

One person who won't need a post-show workout is Jamie Hewlett – who dreamt up the idea of Gorillaz as a "virtual group" with Albarn in 1998.

He's roving the stadium with a camera crew, shooting a documentary commemorating this one-off event.

Ambitiously, the end...
body.zh: 周五晚上，在托特纳姆热刺体育场，他正在为 Gorillaz 的首场体育场演出进行排练——这是一场多元文化、多媒体的流行盛宴，客人数量比 Airbnb 上的双重预订还要多。 当乐队开始演奏《Dirty Harry》时，球场边的 LED 长屏幕上会亮起卡通合唱团的声音，唱着歌曲的副歌“我所做的就是跳舞”。 阿尔本显然很惊讶，他从舞台上跳下来观看，脸上露出露齿的笑容。然后他看到阿根廷说唱歌手特鲁诺大步穿过体育场的地板，他冲过去拥抱了他。 乐队在没有领队的情况下继续演奏 - 阿尔巴恩花了近 10 分钟才意识到舞台上可能需要他。 恰恰相反：阿尔本悠闲的氛围为整个随行人员定下了基调。 托特纳姆热刺队的后台有来自 15 个不同国家的 30 多名音乐家，他们之间没有一丝自负。 “这种氛围太荒谬了，”南非歌手 Moonchild Sanelly 说道。 “达蒙很开放，他很酷，他很谦虚。 “每个他欣赏其艺术的人，他都会带他们一起去。即使他心情不好，我也会去坐在他旁边，这样我们就可以呼吸彼此的空气。” “这肯定是一个不拘一格的家庭，”民谣歌手兼诗人卡拉·杰克逊 (Kara Jackson) 说，她是 Gorillaz 最近演出的常客。 “这有点像来自南方，我来自美国。你有表兄弟姐妹，但他们并不是你真正的表兄弟姐妹——这些年来你只是称呼你妈妈最好的朋友为你的阿姨。” 在幕后，它就像一个音乐联合国。马里歌手法图玛塔·迪亚瓦拉 (Fatoumata Diawara) 穿着传统的瓦苏卢 (Wassoulou) 服装聊天，而约翰尼·马尔 (Johnny Marr) 则穿着同样传统的曼彻斯特派克大衣悠闲地走过。 美国另类流行音乐英雄斯帕克斯 (Sparks) 在英国夏令时 17:00 刚过，就开着一辆黑色宝马停下来，打开后备箱取回他们的舞台服装（拉塞尔 (Russell) 穿着粉色圆点套装，罗恩 (Ron) 穿着葬礼服装）。 二十分钟后，他们在舞台上排练《快乐独裁者》；接下来是 Shaun Ryder，他在 2005 年的经典电影 Dare！ 在食堂里，叙利亚和非洲音乐家与 De La Soul 乐队的 Posdnuos 和西塔琴传奇人物 Anoushka Shankar 一起大快朵颐。菜单上有蜜汁酸橙鸡、烤鲈鱼、焦糖韭葱通心粉和极其美味的百香果蛋白酥皮。 “当我们第一次和 Gorillaz 一起巡演时（2010 年），我的体重增加了很多，以至于当我回到家时，我不得不去健身房锻炼身体。” 杰米·休利特 (Jamie Hewlett) 就是一个不需要赛后锻炼的人，他在 1998 年提出了将 Gorillaz 与 Albarn 组成“虚拟团体”的想法。 他与摄制组一起在体育场内巡游，拍摄一部纪录片来纪念这一一次性事件。 雄心勃勃，最终结果将...

reflection.en: The immense praise and "ridiculous vibe" surrounding a major performance highlight the powerful effect of public acclaim. Proverbs 27:21 reminds us that just as fire refines metals, the praise a person receives can test their character, revealing what truly lies within. It's a call to humility and self-awareness, even in moments of great success.
reflection.zh: 围绕着一场盛大演出的巨大赞誉和“不可思议的氛围”，凸显了公众赞扬的强大影响力。箴言27:21提醒我们，正如火炼净金属一样，人所受到的赞扬也能考验其品格，显露其内心深处。这呼吁我们在巨大成功之时，仍要保持谦逊和自我认知。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: France bans alcohol at music festival events under red heatwave alert
title.zh: 法国在红色高温警报下禁止音乐节活动饮酒

summary.en: French authorities have banned alcohol at music festival events in areas under a red heatwave alert, where temperatures reached 40C (104F). The measure is intended to help preserve healthcare services during the annual street parties attended by millions.
summary.zh: 法国当局已在红色高温警报区域的音乐节活动中禁止饮酒，当地气温达到40摄氏度（104华氏度）。此举旨在数百万民众参加的年度街头派对期间，帮助保护医疗服务。

body.en:
France has banned alcohol at some events at a massive national music festival on Sunday as a heatwave pushes temperatures towards record levels.

Annual Fête de la Musique celebrations draw millions to the streets across France. But with a third of the country covered by the most serious heatwave warnings, the government has banned alcohol consumption in public places under the red alerts.

"For all events organised by the state and its agencies, instructions have been given not to offer alcohol," the office of Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said.

Temperatures of 39-40C (102-104F) are expected from the southwest through the Paris region into Burgundy on Sunday, with some areas possibly reaching 41C.

Temperatures have been forecast to peak on Monday, and authorities have warned they could match historic highs.

The government has called for limits on alcohol consumption "to preserve emergency and healthcare services and allow medical staff to focus on caring for the most vulnerable".

The heatwave has been going for days and has disrupted the country, forcing the cancellation of dozens of trains and the suspension of classes.

France's weather service Météo-France said it was "uncertain" how long the heatwave, which has been estimated to affect about three quarters of the population, would last.

To help Parisians and tourists cope with the heat, authorities are keeping parks and gardens in the French capital open through the night.

Fête de la Musique has been going for more than 40 years, and is always held on the summer solstice.
body.zh: 由于热浪将气温推向创纪录水平，法国周日在大型全国音乐节的部分活动中禁止饮酒。 一年一度的音乐节庆祝活动吸引了数百万人走上法国街头。但由于该国三分之一的地区受到最严重的热浪警告，政府已在红色警报下禁止在公共场所饮酒。 总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努办公室表示：“国家及其机构组织的所有活动均已接到指示，不得提供酒精饮料。” 预计周日从西南部经巴黎地区进入勃艮第的气温将达到 39-40 摄氏度（102-104 华氏度），部分地区可能达到 41 摄​​氏度。 预计气温将于周一达到峰值，当局警告称，气温可能会达到历史最高水平。 政府呼吁限制饮酒，“以维持紧急和医疗服务，并让医务人员专注于照顾最弱势群体”。 热浪已经持续数天，扰乱了整个国家，迫使数十列火车取消并停课。 法国气象局表示，目前“不确定”热浪会持续多久，据估计，热浪将影响约四分之三的人口。 为了帮助巴黎人和游客应对炎热天气，当局让法国首都的公园和花园通宵开放。 Fête de la Musique 已经举办了 40 多年，并且总是在夏至举行。

reflection.en: The extreme heat in France prompted authorities to ban alcohol at festivals, a measure aimed at preventing a surge in heat-related illnesses and preserving vital healthcare services. This decision reflects the wisdom of foreseeing danger and taking proactive steps to protect the community. In challenging times, prudence guides us to anticipate potential...
reflection.zh: 法国极端高温促使当局禁止音乐节饮酒，此举旨在预防与高温相关的疾病激增，并保护重要的医疗服务。这一决定体现了预见危险并采取积极措施保护社区的智慧。在充满挑战的时期，审慎引导我们预见潜在的危害，并为所有人的福祉负责任地采取行动。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: At CrimeCon true crime obsessives come face-to-face with real loss
title.zh: 在“犯罪大会”上，真实犯罪迷们直面真实的损失

summary.en: At CrimeCon, an event for true-crime enthusiasts, victims' families shared their perspectives on how fans can engage with their stories respectfully. They emphasized the importance of ethical consumption of true crime content, distinguishing it from exploitative practices.
summary.zh: 在“犯罪大会”上，真实犯罪爱好者们与受害者家属面对面交流。受害者家属强调，真实犯罪的粉丝可以有道德地参与，而不是以剥削的方式。

body.en:
Podcasters rub shoulders with prosecutors, and attendees - wearing T-shirts emblazoned with slogans like "True Crime And Wine" or "I'm Only Here For An Alibi" - carry conference-provided bags stamped with "unsolved crime is a choice".

Amongst rows of booths, one woman stands apart, staring stoically ahead as people pass by pictures of her murdered daughter.

They are all here for CrimeCon, an annual gathering of true-crime enthusiasts, content creators, investigators, advocates, survivors and victims' relatives.

But for many - including stoic mom Dr Maggie Zingman - their reasons for being here are deeply personal.

In 2004, the trauma psychologist's daughter, Brittany Phillips, was murdered, and her case has never been solved.

Zingman has refused to give up her search for answers, making more than two-dozen trips across the country in a wrapped pink and purple vehicle loudly telling the world about her child's case. CrimeCon is one of her stops.

Zingman recognises the event's inherent contradictions, as it tries to build an audience - and turn a profit - from real-life tragedies.

"It's a balance," Zingman says. "I wouldn't get 8,000 people learning about my story if it wasn't here."

For more than a decade, America has been gripped by a true crime obsession. Experts point to game-changing podcasts like 2014's Serial and docuseries like The Jinx and Making a Murderer, which both came out in 2015, as early examples that helped fuel the craze.

And CrimeCon has grown alongside the true-crime genre. The inaugural event in 2017 drew just 800, but attendance jumped to 2,400 the following year, according to co-founder Kevin Balfe. This year, 6,500 people attended, with some paying more than $1,600 for a VIP experience.

But as the genre has grown, so has the criticism. Many note how much of the content has focused on the perpetrators - not the victims - of the crimes, and the inherent exploitation that comes from profiting from other people's misfortune.

It is a fine line to walk, and those who have been coming to CrimeCon for years say the event endeavours to do things right.

Wearing T-shirts proclaiming "Victim exploitation does not equal victim advocacy", the parents of Gabby Petito have their own booth to promote their foundation, which supports missing persons cases and domestic violence prevention. Their daughter made national headlines when she was murdered by her boyfriend during a cross-country van trip , sparking a nationwide manhunt.

"From the first year that we came here, we saw a lot of growth in terms of who's going to come," says Petito's father, Joe, who first attended in 2023, noting how groups like the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children and the Black and Missing Foundation use CrimeCon to raise awareness for their...
body.zh: 播客与检察官擦肩而过，与会者穿着印有“真实犯罪与美酒”或“我只是为了不在场证明”等标语的 T 恤，提着会议提供的袋子，袋子上印着“悬而未决的犯罪是一种选择”。 在一排排的摊位中，一名妇女站在一边，当人们经过她被谋杀的女儿的照片时，她坚忍地凝视着前方。 他们都来这里参加犯罪大会，这是一年一度的犯罪爱好者、内容创作者、调查人员、倡导者、幸存者和受害者亲属的聚会。 但对许多人来说——包括坚忍的妈妈玛吉·辛曼博士——他们来到这里的原因是非常个人化的。 2004年，创伤心理学家的女儿布列塔尼·菲利普斯被谋杀，她的案子一直没有侦破。 辛曼拒绝放弃寻找答案，她开着一辆粉红色和紫色包裹的汽车在全国各地进行了两次以上的旅行，大声向全世界讲述她孩子的案件。犯罪大会是她的一站。 辛曼认识到这一事件的内在矛盾，因为它试图从现实生活的悲剧中吸引观众并从中获利。 “这是一种平衡，”辛曼说。 “如果我的故事不在这里，我就不会有 8,000 人了解我的故事。” 十多年来，美国一直被真正的犯罪困扰所困扰。专家指出，2014 年推出的 Serial 等改变游戏规则的播客以及 2015 年推出的《The Jinx》和《Making a Murderer》等纪录片系列是助长这一热潮的早期例子。 CrimeCon 与真实犯罪类型一起成长。联合创始人凯文·巴尔夫 (Kevin Balfe) 表示，2017 年首届活动仅吸引了 800 人，但第二年参加人数跃升至 2,400 人。今年，有 6,500 人参加，其中一些人支付了超过 1,600 美元以获得 VIP 体验。 但随着这一类型的发展，批评也随之增加。许多人注意到，有多少内容集中在犯罪者（而不是受害者）上，以及从他人的不幸中获利所带来的固有剥削。 这是一条很难走的路，那些多年来一直参加犯罪大会的人都表示，该活动致力于做正确的事情。 加比·佩蒂托 (Gabby Petito) 的父母身穿印有“受害者剥削并不等于为受害者辩护”的 T 恤，拥有自己的摊位来宣传他们的基金会，该基金会支持失踪人员案件和预防家庭暴力。他们的女儿在越野货车旅行中被男友谋杀，成为全国头条新闻，引发了全国范围内的追捕。 Petito 的父亲 Joe 于 2023 年首次参加，他说：“从我们来到这里的第一年起，我们就看到了来者人数的大幅增长。”他指出，国家失踪和受虐儿童中心以及黑人和失踪基金会等团体如何利用 CrimeCon 来提高人们对他们的……的认识。

reflection.en: Engaging with stories of real loss, even for entertainment, calls for profound empathy and respect. Victims' families remind us that true compassion means honoring their pain and avoiding any form of exploitation. Yahweh calls us to be kind and tenderhearted, especially when confronting the suffering of others.
reflection.zh: 即使是为了娱乐而接触真实损失的故事，也需要深刻的同情和尊重。受害者家属提醒我们，真正的怜悯意味着尊重他们的痛苦，避免任何形式的剥削。雅伟呼召我们，尤其是在面对他人苦难时，要彼此和善，心存怜悯。

verse.textEn: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.
verse.textZh: 并要以恩慈相待，存怜悯的心，彼此饶恕，正如神在基督里饶恕了你们一样。

title.en: Terror police probe suspected anti-Muslim attacks in Edinburgh
title.zh: 恐怖警察调查爱丁堡疑似反穆斯林袭击事件

summary.en: Counterterrorism police are investigating a series of violent attacks in Edinburgh, Scotland, which resulted in five men being injured.
summary.zh: 苏格兰首都爱丁堡发生一系列暴力袭击事件，导致五名男子受伤，反恐警察已接手调查。

body.en:
Counterterrorism police have taken charge after a series of violent attacks in the Scottish capital that left five men injured.

Counterterrorism police have taken over an investigation into suspected anti-Muslim violence in Edinburgh, Scotland , that left five men injured, authorities said Saturday.

The unrest comes as the United Kingdom  is seeing a wave of anti-migrant and anti-Muslim sentiment, including recent riots in Northern Ireland and England .

Emergency services responded late Friday to reports of "violent attacks including threats, robbery and vandalism" across the city, according to a police statement.

Local media reported the attacks began near a mosque before spreading to other areas of the city.

Footage posted to social media appeared to show a shirtless man walking along a street carrying a long weapon.

Another video seemed to show the same man being held on the ground by a police officer and shouting about "protecting the country" from Muslims.

Police said five people — two aged 22 and three others aged 24, 27, and 39 — sustained injuries.

Three of the victims required hospital treatment, but none of the injuries were life-threatening, police said.

A 36-year-old Scottish man was arrested, and authorities said there was no further threat to the public.

"Counter Terrorism Policing Scotland is investigating, supported by other specialist colleagues and local policing officers," the statement said.

The anti-Islamophobia non-profit MEND said several of the victims were Muslims and urged police to "treat this as what the evidence indicates: Islamophobic, far-right terror."

Scotland's First Minister John Swinney said he was "deeply concerned" by the incidents.

Assistant Chief Constable Catriona Paton called for calm, saying "there is no place for racism or faith-based hate in Scotland." The incident follows a broader pattern of unrest across the UK, where tensions over immigration and multiculturalism remain elevated. Critics say far-right groups have been stoking anti-migrant and anti-Muslim sentiment in recent months.

Last week, Belfast saw two nights of serious disorder after a brutal knife attack on a local man.

Video of the incident, allegedly carried out by a Sudanese asylum seeker, spread rapidly online and triggered protests that escalated into violence, with homes and vehicles set on fire.

The week before, protesters clashed with police in Southampton, southern England, over the handling of the murder of 18-year-old student Henry Nowak, who was fatally stabbed by a British Sikh man.

The unrest comes as Reform UK, the anti-immigration populist party led by Nigel Farage, has taken a clear lead in opinion polls.

title.en: Are Ukraine drones really exposing gaps in Russia's defense?
title.zh: 乌克兰无人机真的暴露了俄罗斯防空的漏洞吗？

summary.en: Russian air defenses, once considered highly effective, are reportedly struggling against Ukrainian drone attacks. A recent drone strike on Moscow has intensified discussions about Russia's military vulnerabilities.
summary.zh: 曾被认为几乎坚不可摧的俄罗斯防空系统，据报道正面临乌克兰无人机日益增长的压力。最近对莫斯科的一次袭击重新引发了关于俄罗斯脆弱性的讨论。

body.en:
Once seen as almost impenetrable, Russian air defenses are now under growing strain from Ukrainian drones. A recent attack on Moscow has reignited debate over Russian vulnerabilities.

Ukrainian drones appear to be getting better at bypassing Russian air defenses to strike critical infrastructure.

After Ukrainian drones hit locations across Moscow on June 18 — the largest attack since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine — a debate was sparked about holes in the country's defense net . 

A major oil refinery in Moscow, which supplies 40% of the region's fuel, was set alight and production appeared to have halted for several days after the attack. There were also evacuations at Russia's largest airport. Eyewitnesses flooded social media with footage of what looked like failed air defense interceptions of the drones.

"That impression forms among non-specialists, who see a missile fly past a drone without hitting it ,"  Ruslan Leviev, a Russian dissident, military analyst and founder of the investigative group Conflict Intelligence Team, told DW.

Exiled Russian journalist Ivan Filippov tracks pro-Kremlin bloggers and noted their growing alarm that Ukraine had found a gap in Russian defenses .

"They don't want the war to stop — they want a more effective war," Filippov told DW, meaning radical reform of the defense ministry and Russia's military-industrial complex. "But I think they understand perfectly well that these reforms are impossible. So these texts tend to be pessimistic."

Anatoliy Khrapchynskyi, a Ukrainian aviation expert and former air force officer, attributed the breaching of Moscow's air defense on June 18 to a combination of two factors: A systemic degradation of Russia's defense architecture and the technological evolution of Ukraine 's strike capabilities.

Leviev wasn't so sure. His team did not record weakening of Russia's defenses because it actually downed more than 90% of the UAVs over Moscow. But the few that managed to get by Russian air defenses caused substantial damage.

Leviev believes the core issue is quantity. As the scale of attacks is increasing, this challenge is the same for both Russia and Ukraine: Mass drone attacks demand more hardware than any industry can supply.

Russian systems, including the Pantsir-S1, were designed to counter classic, large-scale attackers like cruise missiles, Khrapchynskyi told DW. They were calibrated against highly radar-reflective targets made of metal — but modern drones are often made from composite materials like plastic or plywood. This means those systems  are basically "blind" to small drones.

The sheer size of the Russian territory is a challenge on its own. Building an unbroken "air wall" or a single "dome" is impossible, Leviev said.

body.zh: 俄罗斯防空系统曾经被视为几乎坚不可摧，但现在却面临着来自乌克兰无人机的越来越大的压力。最近对莫斯科的袭击再次引发了关于俄罗斯脆弱性的争论。 乌克兰无人机似乎越来越擅长绕过俄罗斯防空系统攻击关键基础设施。 6 月 18 日，乌克兰无人机袭击了莫斯科各地——这是俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来最大规模的一次袭击——之后，引发了一场关于该国防御网漏洞的争论。 莫斯科一家供应该地区 40% 燃料的大型炼油厂被纵火，袭击后生产似乎已停止数日。俄罗斯最大的机场也进行了疏散。目击者在社交媒体上发布了看似防空拦截无人机失败的视频。 俄罗斯持不同政见者、军事分析家、调查组织冲突情报小组创始人鲁斯兰·列维耶夫 (Ruslan Leviev) 告诉德国之声：“非专业人士会产生这种印象，他们看到导弹飞过无人机却没有击中它。” 流亡的俄罗斯记者伊万·菲利波夫（Ivan Filippov）追踪亲克里姆林宫的博主，并指出他们对乌克兰发现俄罗斯防御存在漏洞越来越感到担忧。 菲利波夫对德国之声表示：“他们不希望战争停止，他们想要一场更有效的战争。”这意味着对国防部和俄罗斯军工联合体进行彻底改革。 “但我认为他们非常清楚这些改革是不可能的。因此这些文本往往是悲观的。” 乌克兰航空专家、前空军军官阿纳托利·赫拉普琴斯基 (Anatoliy Khrapchynskyi) 将 6 月 18 日莫斯科防空系统的突破归因于两个因素：俄罗斯防御体系的系统性退化和乌克兰打击能力的技术演变。 列维耶夫不太确定。他的团队并没有记录俄罗斯防御能力的削弱，因为他们实际上击落了莫斯科上空90%以上的无人机。但少数成功突破俄罗斯防空系统的飞机造成了重大损失。 莱维耶夫认为，核心问题是数量。随着攻击规模不断扩大，俄罗斯和乌克兰面临同样的挑战：大规模无人机攻击所需的硬件超出了任何行业的供应能力。 赫拉普钦斯基告诉德国之声，包括“铠甲-S1”在内的俄罗斯系统旨在对抗巡航导弹等经典的大规模攻击目标。它们是针对金属制成的高雷达反射目标进行校准的，但现代无人机通常由塑料或胶合板等复合材料制成。这意味着这些系统基本上对小型无人机“视而不见”。 俄罗斯领土面积之大本身就是一个挑战。莱维耶夫说，建造完整的“空气墙”或单个“圆顶”是不可能的。 和...

Psalm 46:9 points to a deeper truth: Yahweh ultimately makes wars cease and breaks the instruments of conflict. This offers a hopeful perspective that beyond the shifting tides of human power, a lasting peace is possible through divine intervention.

title.en: Spain: PM's wife must face corruption trial, judge rules
title.zh: 西班牙：法官裁定首相夫人必须面临腐败审判

summary.en: A court in Madrid has ruled that there is sufficient evidence for the wife of Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, Begona Gomez, to face a corruption trial. The 55-year-old university director is currently banned from leaving the country.
summary.zh: 马德里一家法院裁定，有足够证据对首相佩德罗·桑切斯的妻子贝戈尼亚·戈麦斯提起腐败审判。这位55岁的大学主任已被禁止离境。

body.en:
A court in Madrid ruled that there is sufficient evidence against Begona Gomez, the wife of Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez. The 55-year-old university director is banned from leaving the country.

Begona Gomez, the wife of Spain's prime minister,  Pedro Sanchez , has been ordered to stand trial on corruption charges, a court order released on Saturday said.

Gomez is ‌accused of using her position as the head of government's wife to secure work contracts.

The case is one of several graft cases facing the prime minister's center-left minority government.

The court in Madrid agreed that there was sufficient evidence to bring Gomez's case to trial in front of a jury.

Investigating judge Juan Carlos Peinado told Gomez to surrender ​her passport, barred her from leaving the country and ordered ​her ‌to report to court twice a month.

The court said "instructions shall be issued to all border posts and civilian and military airports" to ensure Gomez remains on home soil.

Sanchez's ​Socialist PSOE party reacted to the ruling on X, saying: "[Gomez] has been subjected to judicial and political ⁠persecution ​for two years. Today's development is another step ​in that process."

The case began with a complaint filed by Manos Limpias (Clean Hands), a legal pressure group set up by a lawyer with ties to the far right.

An investigation was opened in April 2024 to decide whether Gomez had exploited her position as Sanchez's wife for private gain.

It centers on an academic chair at Madrid’s Complutense University that Gómez co-directed, along with allegations that she used public resources and her connections to advance private business interests.

Gomez was  formally charged in April with embezzlement, influence peddling, corruption in business dealings and misappropriation of funds.

She has denied the allegations, while Sanchez has repeatedly refused to step down and call early elections.

Several senior figures close to Sanchez, including the PSOE's number three and his former transport minister, are also under investigation over alleged kickbacks linked to public works contracts, oil and gas deals and the procurement of COVID-19 masks.

Separately, Spain's High Court is investigating former Prime Minister Jose Luis Rodriguez Zapatero over allegations that he headed a lobbying network which profited from influencing public authorities on behalf of third parties, including the airline Plus Ultra.

The cases threaten to bring down Sanchez's fragile coalition government, which came to power in 2018 promising to clean up Spanish politics after toppling the conservative Popular Party (PP) in a no-confidence vote over its own corruption scandal.

title.en: Zelenskyy returns Poland's highest honor as row deepens
title.zh: 泽连斯基退还波兰最高荣誉，两国关系日益紧张

summary.en: Ukraine's president returned Poland's highest honor after being stripped of it, marking a deepening diplomatic dispute between the two key allies in the war against Russia.
summary.zh: 乌克兰总统退还了波兰的最高荣誉勋章，此前波兰决定剥夺他的这项荣誉，这标志着这两个在对俄战争中的关键盟友之间的外交争端正在加剧。

body.en:
Ukraine's president has returned a medal to Poland after a decision to strip him of the country's highest honor. Warsaw has been one of Kyiv's key allies since Russia began its war in Ukraine.

Top Ukrainian officials, including President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said on Saturday that they were returning Polish state honors after Polish President Karol Nawrocki stripped the Ukrainian president of Poland's highest award.

Zelenskyy said in a social media post that he had sent back the Order of the White Eagle, which he received in 2023 as a symbol of friendship between Poland and Ukraine.

"Ukraine will remain open to all meaningful formats of interaction with Poland, in order to strive to avoid misinterpretations of the complex and painful pages of the past of our peoples and to ensure due respect for all innocent victims of the 20th century," he wrote.

He called the medal a symbol of Poland's "highest trust," but also suggested it no longer held the same meaning after Nawrocki's decision. 

The Polish decision to strip the honor from Zelenskyy could further strain ties between the two close strategic partners as Kyiv seeks to rally international support to pressure Russia to end its war in Ukraine .

"This is a gift to the Moscow aggressor, who will certainly use it against both of our countries," Zelenskyy's chief of staff, Kyrylo Budanov, wrote on social media, saying that he was returning the Gold Officer's Cross of the Polish Order of Merit. 

On Friday, Nawrocki announced that Zelenskyy would be stripped of the Order of the White Eagle — Poland's highest state honor, which had been awarded by former President Andrzej Duda in 2023.

The decision followed Zelenskyy's move to name a military unit after the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA) ,  a World War II militia that Warsaw accuses of participating in massacres of Poles.

Poland has been one of Ukraine's key allies since Russia's full-scale invasion, hosting hundreds of thousands of Ukrainian refugees.

Nawrocki said the move would not affect Poland's support for Ukraine's defense against Russia. 

Ukraine's ambassador to Warsaw, Vasyl Bodnar, described the move "as a gesture towards all the Ukrainian people" and announced that he was relinquishing his Knight's Cross of the Polish Order of Merit.

Foreign Minister Andriy Sybiga also said that he would return a Polish award he received in 2022, calling the decision "a strategic mistake … that benefits only Moscow."

Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk , a political rival of Nawrocki, urged both countries to preserve their solidarity, warning that a dispute between Poland and Ukraine "delights Putin and shocks our allies."

body.zh: 乌克兰总统在决定剥夺他的国家最高荣誉后，将一枚奖章归还给波兰。自俄罗斯在乌克兰发动战争以来，华沙一直是基辅的主要盟友之一。 包括总统泽伦斯基在内的乌克兰高级官员周六表示，在波兰总统卡罗尔·纳罗基剥夺了乌克兰总统的波兰最高奖项后，他们将归还波兰国家荣誉。 泽连斯基在社交媒体帖子中表示，他已将2023年收到的白鹰勋章寄回，作为波兰和乌克兰友谊的象征。 他写道：“乌克兰将继续对与波兰进行所有有意义的互动形式持开放态度，以避免对我们两国人民复杂而痛苦的过去的误解，并确保对20世纪所有无辜受害者的应有尊重。” 他称该奖章是波兰“最高信任”的象征，但也暗示在诺罗基做出决定后，该奖章不再具有相同的含义。 波兰决定剥夺泽连斯基的荣誉可能会进一步加剧这两个密切战略伙伴之间的关系，因为基辅寻求争取国际支持，向俄罗斯施压，要求其结束乌克兰战争。 泽连斯基的幕僚长凯里洛·布达诺夫在社交媒体上写道：“这是送给莫斯科侵略者的礼物，他们肯定会用它来对付我们两国。”他表示，泽连斯基将归还波兰军官金质十字勋章。 周五，纳罗基宣布将取消泽连斯基的白鹰勋章——波兰最高国家荣誉，由前总统安杰伊·杜达于 2023 年授予。 这一决定是在泽伦斯基以乌克兰起义军（UPA）的名字命名一支军事单位之后做出的。乌克兰起义军是一支二战民兵组织，华沙指责其参与了对波兰人的屠杀。 自俄罗斯全面入侵以来，波兰一直是乌克兰的主要盟友之一，收容了数十万乌克兰难民。 纳罗基表示，此举不会影响波兰对乌克兰防御俄罗斯的支持。 乌克兰驻华沙大使瓦西里·博德纳尔称此举“是对所有乌克兰人民的一个姿态”，并宣布他将放弃波兰骑士十字勋章。 外交部长安德烈·西比加 (Andriy Sybiga) 还表示，他将归还 2022 年获得的波兰奖项，称这一决定“是一个战略错误……只会对莫斯科有利”。 诺罗基的政治对手、波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克敦促两国保持团结，并警告说，波兰和乌克兰之间的争端“让普京感到高兴，但让我们的盟友感到震惊”。 与此同时，俄罗斯对乌克兰东部城市哈尔科夫的空袭造成至少一人死亡……

reflection.en: Even strong alliances can face strain when grievances arise, as seen in the diplomatic dispute between Ukraine and Poland. The Scripture reminds us of the importance of bearing with one another and forgiving, especially when relationships are tested by perceived slights or disagreements. Cultivating such grace is vital for maintaining unity and common...
reflection.zh: 即使是坚固的盟友关系，当出现不满时也会面临压力，正如乌克兰和波兰之间的外交争端所显示的那样。圣经提醒我们，尤其当关系因被视为轻视或分歧而受到考验时，彼此包容和饶恕是多么重要。培养这种恩典对于维持团结和共同目标至关重要。

verse.textEn: Bear with each other and forgive one another if any of you has a grievance against someone.
verse.textZh: 倘若这人与那人有嫌隙，总要彼此包容，彼此饶恕。

title.en: One killed and dozens hurt in train collision north of London
title.zh: 伦敦北部发生火车相撞事故，造成一人死亡数十人受伤

summary.en: A train collision north of London resulted in one fatality and dozens of injuries. Social media footage depicted the front of one train entangled with the rear of another.
summary.zh: 伦敦北部发生火车相撞事故，造成一人死亡，数十人受伤。社交媒体上发布的视频显示，一列火车的车头与另一列火车的车尾缠绕在一起。

body.en:
A train driver has died and dozens more injured in a collision between two commuter services in London on Friday.

Both trains were travelling south to London St Pancras station on Friday afternoon when they collided outside the town of Bedford, about 100km north of London. The trains were travelling from Corby and Nottingham respectively.

East Midlands Railway, which operated both London-bound trains involved in the crash, confirmed in a statement on X on Saturday that the driver of one of the services had been killed. The company had cancelled all trains to and from St Pancras for the rest of Friday and was unable to confirm the schedule for Saturday.

A video posted on social media by one of the passengers showed what appeared to be the front of one train entangled with the back of another, with the carriages appearing to remain upright on the tracks.

The East of England Ambulance Service said that in addition to a person who died at the scene, 11 people suffered very serious injuries, 22 were seriously injured and 56 had minor injuries.

"My thoughts are with the family of the person who has sadly lost their life, and with those who have been seriously injured," Prime Minister Keir Starmer said in a statement.

The cause of the incident was not immediately known, and transport minister Heidi Alexander said an investigation was underway.

Peter Knapp, a doctor who said on social media site Bluesky he was on board one of the trains, described a "sudden crash" with one carriage off the rails and said he had sustained minor injuries.

"There was a moment of being flung into the chair in front, and then I saw smoke," Knapp said.

"I got up and I saw a lot of people who were unable to speak, had broken legs," he said.

"And then I managed to get out of the train and because I'm quite thin I was able to squeeze out through the gap in the doors."

Various posts on social media showed dozens of people, some with bandages but many who appeared uninjured, standing and sitting among emergency vehicles parked on a road that runs parallel to the train tracks.

The RMT union, which represents many railway workers, said it was monitoring the situation and expressed its concern over reports of "serious injuries" suffered by both train staff and passengers.

body.zh: 周五，伦敦两趟通勤服务发生碰撞，一名火车司机死亡，数十人受伤。 周五下午，两列火车均向南行驶至伦敦圣潘克拉斯车站，在伦敦以北约 100 公里的贝德福德镇外相撞。火车分别从科比和诺丁汉出发。 东米德兰铁路公司（East Midlands Railway）周六在一份声明中证实，其中一趟列车的司机已死亡。该公司取消了周五剩余时间内往返圣潘克拉斯的所有火车，并且无法确认周六的时刻表。 一名乘客在社交媒体上发布的一段视频显示，一列火车的车头似乎与另一列火车的车尾纠缠在一起，车厢似乎保持直立在铁轨上。 英格兰东部救护车服务处表示，除了一名当场死亡的人外，还有11人伤势非常严重，22人重伤，56人轻伤。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 总理基尔·斯塔默在一份声明中说：“我的心与不幸丧生者的家人以及那些受重伤的人同在。” 事件原因尚不清楚，交通部长海蒂·亚历山大表示调查正在进行中。 医生彼得·纳普 (Peter Knapp) 在社交媒体网站 Bluesky 上表示，他当时正在其中一列火车上，他描述了一场“突然相撞”，其中一节车厢脱轨，并表示他受了轻伤。 “有一瞬间我被扔到前面的椅子上，然后我看到了烟雾，”纳普说。 “我站起来，看到很多人无法说话，腿都断了，”他说。 “然后我设法下了火车，因为我很瘦，所以我能够从车门的缝隙中挤出来。” 社交媒体上的各种帖子显示，数十人站着或坐在停在与铁轨平行的道路上的紧急车辆中间，其中一些人缠着绷带，但许多人似乎没有受伤。 代表许多铁路工人的 RMT 工会表示，正在密切关注事态发展，并对列车工作人员和乘客遭受“严重伤害”的报道表示担忧。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The suddenness of this tragic accident, with lives lost and many injured, reminds us of life's fragility and the pain that can strike unexpectedly. In moments of profound grief and suffering, we hold onto the hope that Yahweh promises a future where tears, death, and pain will be no more.
reflection.zh: 这场突如其来的悲剧性事故，造成生命逝去和多人受伤，提醒我们生命的脆弱以及意想不到的痛苦。在深切的悲伤和痛苦时刻，我们紧紧抓住雅伟所应许的盼望，即将来不会再有眼泪、死亡和痛苦。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Petrol prices in Australia are now lower than before the Iran war began. Is the oil crisis over and what happens next?
title.zh: 澳大利亚汽油价格已低于伊朗战争爆发前水平。石油危机结束了吗？接下来会发生什么？

summary.en: Australian petrol prices have fallen below pre-Middle East conflict levels, surprising analysts who had warned of shortages and record high prices. This unexpected flexibility from non-Middle Eastern fuel suppliers, including China, has led to a significant drop in costs.

Just as weeping may endure for a night, joy can indeed come in the morning, often through unforeseen circumstances. This turn of events offers a hopeful perspective on how challenges can resolve in ways we...
reflection.zh: 汽油价格在最初警告可能出现短缺和创纪录高位后，意外下降，这提醒我们，焦虑时期可能会迎来缓解。正如哭泣可能持续一夜，喜乐确实会在早晨到来，而且常常是通过意想不到的情况。这一转变提供了一个充满希望的视角，说明挑战可能以我们未曾预料的方式得到解决。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: Charging ahead: EVs outpace growth predictions
title.zh: 电动汽车：超越增长预期，加速前进

summary.en: Electric vehicles are becoming more affordable, efficient, and capable of longer distances, exceeding initial growth forecasts. China is leading this transition, with Europe and other nations rapidly advancing as well.
summary.zh: 电动汽车正变得更便宜、更高效，续航里程也比以往任何时候都长，其增长速度超出了预期。中国正在推动这一转型，而欧洲和其他国家也正在迅速追赶。

body.zh: 电动汽车变得越来越便宜、越来越高效，而且行驶距离比以往任何时候都更远。中国正在推动这一转型，但欧洲和其他国家正在快速追赶。 全球电动汽车 (EV) 市场的增长速度远远快于预期。短短六年内，销量增长了十倍，到 2025 年，全球电动汽车销量将达到约 2100 万辆。 中国和欧洲处于领先地位，但世界其他地区的市场也在快速增长。 中国长期以来一直在投资太阳能和风能以及电池技术——电动汽车最关键的组成部分。 得益于先进的研究和大规模生产，电动汽车电池成本大幅下降。如今，它们的成本仅为 10 年前的四分之一，而且价格还在继续下降。 中国是世界上最大的汽车市场，消费者正在从政府的产业战略中获益。自 2024 年以来，电动汽车的成本低于内燃机汽车，国家多年来一直在迅速扩大充电基础设施，而且中国的电力非常实惠。 2015年，电动汽车仅占中国新车销量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，这一比例已攀升至 61%。 电动汽车依靠电力运行并通过电缆充电。在全球范围内，三分之二的电动汽车是所谓的电池电动汽车 (BEV)，仅由电力驱动。剩下的三分之一还配备了燃气发动机，用于长途旅行时的备用——这些被称为增程电动汽车 (EREV) 或插电式混合动力电动汽车 (PHEV)。 相比之下，所谓的混合动力电动汽车 (HEV) 始终需要汽油或柴油来为其内燃机提供动力。电动机提供一些帮助，仅通过再生制动产生电力。这项技术在一定程度上降低了城市驾驶的燃油消耗，但混合动力汽车在国际统计中并未被算作电动汽车。 2018年，电动汽车仅占欧盟新车注册量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，售出的新车中近三分之一是电动汽车。 北欧处于领先地位。在挪威，现在销售的几乎所有新车都是电动汽车（99%），其次是丹麦（82%）和瑞典（65%）。该地区各国政府支持气候友好型出行，并正在扩大充电基础设施。 在英国，2026 年 4 月注册的新车中有 39% 是电动汽车，其次是德国（37%）和法国（32%）。在这三个国家，电动汽车销量与去年同月相比都翻了一番。 近年来，美国市场陷入停滞。 2023 年至 2025 年间，电动汽车占...

reflection.en: The rapid advancements in electric vehicle technology, making them cheaper and more efficient, reflect a remarkable acceleration of human knowledge and innovation. This progress reminds us of the human capacity to explore and develop new solutions, continually expanding our understanding and capabilities.
reflection.zh: 电动汽车技术日新月异，变得更便宜、更高效，这反映了人类知识和创新的显著加速。这种进步提醒我们，人类有能力探索和开发新的解决方案，不断拓展我们的理解和能力。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: For women in China frustrated by sexism, female comics are offering a release
title.zh: 在中国，女性喜剧演员为厌倦性别歧视的女性提供宣泄出口

summary.en: Standup comedy in China is providing a platform for women to discuss sensitive topics, including sexism, offering a sense of release and shared experience. Performers, however, remain cautious of censorship limits as they navigate this space in venues like a small performing arts theatre in east Beijing.
summary.zh: 中国的脱口秀喜剧为女性提供了一个平台，让她们可以讨论包括性别歧视在内的敏感话题，从而获得宣泄和共同的体验。然而，表演者们在北京东部一家小型表演艺术剧院等场所进行表演时，仍对审查限制保持警惕。

body.en: Standup comedy gives women a space to talk about certain topics that have become more sensitive, while performers remain wary of censorship limits Packed into the upstairs theatre of a small performing arts space in east Beijing, more than 100 people, mostly women, are giddy with anticipation. “Who did you come to see?” asks the MC, fashionably dressed in a faded denim two-piece suit. The answer is bellowed in unison back to him: “Fang Zhuren!” Fang Shaoli, AKA Director Fang ( Fang Zhuren ), has built a cult following in China in the past two years. Decidedly less fashionable than the evening’s host, Fang is dressed in a yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans. Her everywoman attire is part of the appeal. With a stout frame and short, sensible haircut, Fang, who was born in 1975, hails from rural part of east China’s Shandong province. Before discovering the art of standup comedy she worked in factories and on construction sites, but mainly lived as a housewife to a difficult husband. Her jokes riff on the deep sexism that permeates Chinese culture, particularly away from the big urban centres like Beijing and Shanghai. Continue reading...
body.zh: 单口喜剧为女性提供了谈论某些变得更加敏感的话题的空间，而表演者们仍然对审查制度的限制保持警惕北京东部一个小型表演艺术空间的楼上剧场里，有 100 多人（其中大部分是女性）满怀期待。 “你是来看谁的？”身穿褪色牛仔两件套西装的主持人问道。对方齐声喊道：“方主任！”方绍立，又名方主任（方主任），过去两年在中国建立了一批狂热的追随者。方穿着黄色连帽衫和深蓝色牛仔裤，明显不如当晚主持人时尚。她的普通女性着装是其吸引力的一部分。方出生于1975年，来自中国东部山东省的农村地区，身材魁梧，留着一头漂亮的短发。在发现单口喜剧艺术之前，她曾在工厂和建筑工地工作过，但主要是作为一位难相处的丈夫的家庭主妇生活。她的笑话反复提及了渗透在中国文化中的根深蒂固的性别歧视，尤其是在远离北京和上海等大城市中心的地方。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story highlights the human need to express frustrations and experiences, especially when facing societal pressures like sexism. Proverbs 31:8-9 reminds us of the importance of speaking up for those whose voices are often unheard, advocating for justice and dignity. Even in challenging environments, creative expression can offer a vital space for shared...
reflection.zh: 这个故事突显了人类表达挫折和经历的需求，尤其是在面对性别歧视等社会压力时。箴言31:8-9提醒我们，为那些常常被忽视的声音发声，倡导公义和尊严是何等重要。即使在充满挑战的环境中，创造性的表达也能为共同的理解和释放提供一个重要的空间，这反映了雅伟对边缘群体的关怀。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Border Force officer and Hong Kong trade official jailed for spying for China
title.zh: 英国边境部队官员和香港贸易官员因替中国从事间谍活动被判入狱

summary.en: A UK Border Force officer and a Hong Kong trade official have been sentenced to 10 and eight years in prison, respectively, after being convicted of spying for China. These are the first convictions under the UK's National Security Act.
summary.zh: 一名英国边境部队官员和一名香港贸易官员因替中国从事间谍活动而被判入狱，刑期分别为10年和8年。这是英国根据《国家安全法》首次定罪的案件。

body.en: Peter Wai and Bill Yuen sentenced to 10 and eight years at Old Bailey in first convictions under National Security Act A UK Border Force officer and a Hong Kong trade official based in London have been jailed for spying for China in the first such conviction in British criminal history. Peter Wai, who conducted “shadow policing” operations on Chinese dissidents in the UK, was sentenced to 10 years, while his handler, Bill Yuen, received an eight-year term. Continue reading...
body.zh: Peter Wai和Bill Yuen根据《国家安全法》首次在老贝利被判刑10年和8年。一名英国边防部队官员和一名驻伦敦的香港贸易官员因为中国从事间谍活动而被判入狱，这是英国犯罪史上的首次此类定罪。在英国对中国持不同政见者进行“影子警察”行动的韦彼得被判处10年徒刑，而他的经纪人袁比尔则被判处8年徒刑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights the profound breach of trust when public officials betray their duties. Yahweh's word reminds us that faithfulness in small responsibilities reflects our character in larger ones. May we all strive for integrity in every role we are given, understanding that honesty builds trust and strengthens the fabric of society.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了公职人员背叛职责时对信任的严重破坏。雅伟的话语提醒我们，在小事上忠心的人，在大事上也忠心。愿我们都在所担任的每一个角色中追求正直，明白诚实能建立信任并巩固社会结构。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
verse.textZh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

title.en: Inspired by Ukraine, and worried by China: Taiwan teaches its citizens how to fly drones
title.zh: 受乌克兰启发，担忧中国大陆：台湾教导市民如何驾驶无人机

summary.en: Ordinary citizens in Taiwan are enrolling in drone piloting courses, inspired by events in Ukraine and concerned about a potential military threat from China. These courses teach participants, young and old, how to operate drones for various purposes.
summary.zh: 受乌克兰局势的启发并担忧中国大陆的军事威胁，台湾普通民众（包括年轻人和老年人）正在参加无人机驾驶课程。这些课程旨在教授学员如何操作无人机以应对潜在情况。

body.en: Ordinary Taiwanese, young and old, are joining courses to learn how to fly drones amid looming China military threat In a small, crowded room in Taipei, Pan Chien-chin is trying to keep a drone hovering steadily. Imagining himself flying a plane, he gently nudges controller joysticks to guide the insect-like device as it hums through the air. Cheers break out as Pan, who has never flown a drone before, steers it around a rectangular course marked by traffic cones without crashing. Around him are about two dozen fellow trainees, all signed up for the same course: Taiwan’s first civil defence drone training programme. Continue reading...
body.zh: 台湾普通民众，无论老少，都在参加课程，学习如何在迫在眉睫的中国军事威胁下驾驶无人机。在台北一间拥挤的小房间里，潘建钦正努力让无人机保持稳定盘旋。他想象自己驾驶一架飞机，轻轻推动控制器操纵杆，引导昆虫般的设备在空中嗡嗡作响。当潘以前从未驾驶过无人机时，他驾驶无人机绕着一个由交通锥标标记的矩形航线飞行，没有坠毁，引发了欢呼声。他周围大约有两打学员，他们都报名参加同一门课程：台湾首个民防无人机训练计划。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story highlights a community's proactive response to perceived threats, reflecting a natural human inclination to prepare for potential dangers. Proverbs reminds us of the wisdom in foreseeing trouble and taking steps to protect ourselves and our communities. Such foresight, when coupled with a reliance on Yahweh, can guide us in uncertain times.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻讲述了一个社区如何积极应对潜在威胁，反映了人类为可能出现的危险做准备的自然倾向。箴言提醒我们，预见祸患并采取措施保护自己和社区是智慧之举。这种远见，若能与对雅伟的信靠结合，便能在不确定的时期指引我们。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Lululemon apologises after Japanese drum row at Great Wall yoga event
title.zh: Lululemon因长城瑜伽活动中的日本太鼓风波致歉

summary.en: The activewear brand Lululemon issued an apology after an online uproar in China. The controversy stemmed from a promotional yoga event held on the Great Wall of China, where a Japanese taiko drum was mistakenly featured instead of a Chinese drum, despite the event being intended to celebrate Chinese culture.
summary.zh: 运动服饰品牌Lululemon因在中国长城举办的瑜伽推广活动中误用日本太鼓而引发网络争议后，发表了道歉声明。尽管该活动旨在庆祝中国文化，但这一失误在中国引发了线上轩然大波。

body.en: Online uproar follows Canadian brand’s use of taiko drum at sponsored festival held to celebrate Chinese culture The activewear brand Lululemon has apologised after a promotional event held on the Great Wall of China appeared to mistakenly feature a Japanese drum, prompting an uproar. The Canadian-headquartered company, known for its upmarket leggings, has been growing rapidly in China and arranged for a yoga festival to take place in late May on a section of the wall near Beijing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 加拿大品牌在为庆祝中国文化而举办的赞助节日上使用太鼓，在中国引起网络轩然大波运动服品牌 Lululemon 在中国长城举行的一次促销活动中错误地使用了日本太鼓，引发轩然大波，该品牌已道歉。这家总部位于加拿大的公司以其高档瑜伽紧身裤而闻名，在中国发展迅速，并于五月底在北京附近的一段长城举办了一场瑜伽节。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This incident reminds us how quickly a seemingly small cultural misstep can ignite widespread public sentiment, especially in the digital age. Just as a tiny spark can set a vast forest ablaze, unintentional actions or symbols can inadvertently cause significant uproar and division. It underscores the need for careful consideration and humility in our...
reflection.zh: 这起事件提醒我们，一个看似微小的文化失误，尤其在数字时代，能多么迅速地引发广泛的公众情绪。正如一点火花能点燃整片森林，无意的行为或象征也可能不经意间造成巨大的争议和分歧。这强调了我们在互动中需要谨慎思考和谦卑，认识到即使是微小的细节也可能产生深远的影响。

verse.textEn: The tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.
verse.textZh: 舌头在百体里也是最小的，却能说大话。看哪，最小的火能点着最大的树林。

title.en: They were forced into marriage and abused. Now women facing exploitation in China have a glimmer of hope
title.zh: 她们被迫结婚并遭受虐待。现在，中国面临剥削的女性有了一线希望

summary.en: Female activists are secretly working to locate and assist vulnerable women in China who have been forced into marriage and subjected to abuse, as they believe authorities are not adequately protecting them.
summary.zh: 在中国，女性活动家们正在秘密寻找并帮助那些被迫结婚并遭受虐待的弱势女性，因为她们担心官方未能提供足够的保护。

body.en: Female activists are working in the shadows to find and support vulnerable women they fear are being failed by authorities Last summer, Xiaocao, a softly spoken woman in her 40s, received a tip-off that in Lüliang, a small city in China’s Shanxi province, vulnerable women were being forced into marriages. Along with another volunteer, she wanted to investigate. After leaving Beijing, the two volunteers travelled south for hours, on trains and in rental cars. A few villages turned out to be dead ends. But on the final day of their trip, the women stopped in a county where they’d heard about a woman with learning disabilities who was “married” to two brothers. Soon, they found her. Continue reading...
body.zh: 女性活动人士正在暗中寻找和支持她们担心当局辜负的弱势女性。去年夏天，40 多岁、说话轻声细语的小曹接到举报，称在中国山西省的一个小城市吕梁，弱势女性正在被迫结婚。她想和另一名志愿者一起进行调查。离开北京后，两名志愿者乘坐火车和租车向南行驶了几个小时。一些村庄变成了死胡同。但在旅行的最后一天，妇女们在一个县停下来，她们听说那里有一名有学习障碍的妇女“嫁给”了两个兄弟。很快，他们就找到了她。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story highlights the courageous work of activists who step in when vulnerable individuals are failed by systems meant to protect them. Their efforts embody the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, advocating for justice and dignity for the exploited.
reflection.zh: 这个故事彰显了活动家们的勇气，当弱势群体未能得到应有的保护时，她们挺身而出。她们的努力体现了为那些无法为自己发声的人说话的呼召，为受剥削者争取正义和尊严。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: The Guardian view on the global baby bust: people are having fewer children – even where they say they want more | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》观点：全球生育率暴跌——人们生育的孩子越来越少，即使他们说想要更多 | 社论

summary.en: A new report indicates that global fertility rates are falling faster and spreading further than anticipated, with India's fertility now below the level needed for population stability. This trend means that two-thirds of the world's population now lives in countries with declining birth rates.
summary.zh: 一份新报告指出，全球生育率下降的速度和范围都超出了预期，印度生育率已降至维持人口稳定所需的水平以下。这一趋势意味着全球三分之二的人口生活在生育率下降的国家。

body.en: Indian fertility has fallen below the rate required for population stability, in further evidence of the unexpectedly rapid decline in births internationally The global fall in fertility rates has arrived faster and spread further than anticipated. Two-thirds of people now live in countries that have slipped below the replacement rate – 2.1 births per woman – required for a stable population. Last month, India revealed that its fertility rate had fallen to just 1.9 . The world’s two most populous nations, which pursued cruel and coercive policies to cut births, both face shrinking populations. China’s fertility rate is now around 1, and births last year fell below 8 million – just over half the number projected when the “one child” policy was axed 10 years ago, and comparable to the total in 1738, when its population was 150 million. It’s further proof that what was seen as a phenomenon of rich nations has spread far beyond them. East Asia led the way. But Albania and Chile have far lower rates than the US or England and Wales (themselves experiencing record lows of 1.6 and 1.4). Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? body.zh: 印度的生育率已降至人口稳定所需的水平以下，这进一步证明了国际上出生率出人意料地迅速下降。全球生育率下降的速度和蔓延范围都超出了预期。目前，三分之二的人口生活在人口更替率（每名妇女生育 2.1 胎）以下的国家。上个月，印度透露其生育率已降至仅 1.9。世界上两个人口最多的国家都推行残酷和强制性的政策来减少生育，但都面临着人口萎缩的问题。目前中国的生育率约为1，去年的出生人数跌至800万以下——仅略高于10年前取消“独生子女”政策时预计数字的一半，与1738年的总人口相当，当时的人口为1.5亿。这进一步证明，被视为富裕国家现象的现象已经远远超出了它们的范围。东亚处于领先地位。但阿尔巴尼亚和智利的利率远低于美国或英格兰和威尔士（它们自己也经历过 1.6 和 1.4 的历史低点）。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The global decline in birth rates highlights a significant shift in societal patterns regarding family and future generations. Psalm 127:3 reminds us that children are a heritage from Yahweh, a reward and a blessing that enrich life and carry hope for the future. This perspective invites reflection on the profound value of each new life.
reflection.zh: 全球生育率下降的趋势，反映了社会在家庭和未来世代模式上的重大转变。诗篇127:3提醒我们，儿女是雅伟所赐的产业，是祂所给的赏赐，他们丰富生命，承载着未来的希望。这一视角邀请我们反思每个新生命的深远价值。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: From camel coats to guochao: Max Mara woos China’s luxury brand consumers
title.zh: 从骆驼绒大衣到国潮：Max Mara如何吸引中国奢侈品消费者

summary.en: Luxury fashion brand Max Mara celebrated its 75th anniversary with a catwalk show in Shanghai, paying tribute to Chinese style to attract consumers in China's growing luxury market.
summary.zh: 奢侈时尚品牌Max Mara在上海举办了75周年时装秀，以中国风情致敬当地文化，旨在吸引中国日益增长的奢侈品市场消费者。

body.en: Fashion house pays tribute to Chinese style with its 75th anniversary catwalk show in Shanghai “New York may be the city that never sleeps, but Shanghai doesn’t even sit down.” For the British designer Ian Griffiths, who encountered this line in the New Yorker, it summed up why China’s biggest city was the right place to celebrate Max Mara’s 75th anniversary. “Max Mara is a product for metropolitan women, and it would be patronising to assume that a metropolitan wardrobe should be western-centric,” Griffiths said. Continue reading...
body.zh: 时装屋在上海举办 75 周年时装秀，向中国风致敬 “纽约可能是不夜城，但上海却从不坐下。”对于在《纽约客》上看到这句话的英国设计师 Ian Griffiths 来说，它总结了为什么中国最大的城市是庆祝 Max Mara 75 周年的最佳地点。 “Max Mara 是一款专为都市女性设计的产品，如果认为都市女性的衣橱应该以西方为中心，那就太居高临下了，”Griffiths 说道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The allure of luxury fashion and the relentless pursuit of market share highlight the powerful draw of material wealth and worldly success. This story invites us to consider where our ultimate devotion lies, reminding us that our hearts cannot be fully given to both God and the pursuit of riches.
reflection.zh: 奢华时尚的魅力和对市场份额的孜孜不倦，凸显了物质财富和世俗成功的强大吸引力。这个故事邀请我们思考我们最终的忠诚所在，提醒我们不能同时全心全意地侍奉雅伟和追求财富。

verse.textEn: No one can serve two masters... You cannot serve both God and Mammon.
verse.textZh: 一个人不能事奉两个主……你们不能又事奉神，又事奉玛门。

title.en: US military plans major war stockpile on Australian soil
title.zh: 美国军方计划在澳大利亚建立大型战争储备

summary.en: The United States military is planning a significant accumulation of weapons on Australian territory. This move is described as a key part of an Asia-wide regional defense strategy aimed at countering the growing influence of China.
summary.zh: 美国军方正计划在澳大利亚领土上大量储备武器。此举被描述为一项旨在对抗中国崛起势力的亚洲区域防御战略的关键组成部分。

body.en:
The US military is planning a permanent war-ready weapons stockpile for its marine corps on Australia's southeast coast beyond the range of most Chinese missiles, tender documents show and officials confirmed to the Agence France-Presse news agency (AFP).

The development of the stockpile, a first for the US marine corps in Australia, comes as the United States is keen to leverage the continent's strategic location in the South Pacific to counter China's rapid military build-up, analysts said.

The US marine corps began global prepositioning of military supplies during the Cold War — using floating stores on ships and caves in Norway where weapons, ammunition and vehicles to sustain thousands of troops are kept.

The first land stockpile in the Asia-Pacific region is expected to open this year in the Philippines, close to potential flashpoints in the South China Sea.

Documents published by the US navy this month show advanced planning for an even larger Australian stockpile, with US$30 million ($42.4M) allocated to build warehouses and offices in southeastern Victoria state for "critical forward provisioning".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Australian stockpile, expected to reach full capacity by 2028, will be kept in Melbourne before being moved to US warehouses to be constructed next year at an Australian military base at Bandiana in rural Victoria, tender documents show.

Australia does not permit foreign military bases on its soil, a sensitive issue in a country that has a security alliance with the United States and is hosting an increasing variety of US forces on rotation at Australian defence bases.

The US navy is engaging a global defence contractor to employ around 110 engineers, mechanics, material and safety specialists to manage the Australian stockpile, which includes "crew-served weapons", the documents show.

"Marine corps activities in Australia support integrated global sustainment by maintaining ready-for-issue equipment and supplies for operations and exercises across the Indo-Pacific," a US marine corps forces pacific spokesperson told AFP.

The spokesperson declined to comment on contract details or force planning assumptions but said marines' equipment is kept at "high readiness".

Contracting arrangements and the operation of the facility would be made in close coordination with Australia's Department of Defence.

"These activities improve responsiveness, strengthen interoperability with allies and partners, and support a range of missions across the Indo-Pacific," the spokesperson said, using an alternative description for the Asia-Pacific region.

US army trucks were left at the Bandiana base in 2023 after...
body.zh: 招标文件显示，官员们向法新社（法新社）证实，美国军方正计划在澳大利亚东南海岸为其海军陆战队建立一个永久性的战备武器库存，该武器库位于大多数中国导弹的射程之外。 分析人士表示，这是美国海军陆战队在澳大利亚的首次军备建设，正值美国热衷于利用澳大利亚在南太平洋的战略位置来对抗中国的快速军事集结。 冷战期间，美国海军陆战队开始在全球预先部署军事物资——使用挪威船只和洞穴上的浮动仓库，存放武器、弹药和车辆，以维持数千名士兵的生命。 亚太地区第一个陆地储备预计将于今年在菲律宾开放，靠近南中国海的潜在爆发点。 美国海军本月发布的文件显示，澳大利亚对更大规模的库存进行了高级规划，其中拨款 3000 万美元（合 4240 万美元）用于在维多利亚州东南部建造仓库和办公室，用于“关键的前沿供应”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 招标文件显示，澳大利亚的库存预计将在 2028 年达到满负荷，将存放在墨尔本，然后转移到明年在维多利亚州乡村班迪亚纳的澳大利亚军事基地建造的美国仓库。 澳大利亚不允许在其领土上建立外国军事基地，这对于一个与美国结成安全联盟并在澳大利亚国防基地轮流驻有越来越多美军的国家来说是一个敏感问题。 文件显示，美国海军正在聘请一家全球国防承包商，聘请约 110 名工程师、机械师、材料和安全专家来管理澳大利亚库存，其中包括“船员服务武器”。 美国海军陆战队太平洋发言人告诉法新社：“海军陆战队在澳大利亚的活动通过为整个印太地区的行动和演习提供随时可用的设备和物资来支持全球综合保障。” 该发言人拒绝就合同细节或部队规划假设发表评论，但表示海军陆战队的装备保持“高度准备状态”。 该设施的合同安排和运营将与澳大利亚国防部密切协调。 这位发言人表示：“这些活动提高了响应能力，加强了与盟友和伙伴的互操作性，并支持印太地区的一系列任务。”他用了对亚太地区的另一种描述。 2023 年，美军卡车被留在班迪亚纳基地……

reflection.en: News of increasing military stockpiles highlights the ongoing global tension and the human tendency to seek security through arms. Yet, the prophetic vision reminds us of a future where nations transform instruments of war into tools for peace. This hope encourages us to pray for leaders to pursue paths that lead to true and lasting peace, rather than...
reflection.zh: 关于军事储备增加的消息凸显了持续的全球紧张局势以及人类通过武器寻求安全的倾向。然而，先知的异象提醒我们，未来各国将把战争工具转化为和平工具。这一希望鼓励我们为领导人祷告，愿他们寻求通往真正持久和平的道路，而非升级冲突。

title.en: Angus Taylor dismisses Labor’s ‘half-arsed’ tweaks to CGT reform – as it happened
title.zh: 安格斯·泰勒驳斥工党对资本利得税改革的“半吊子”调整

summary.en: The article reports on a political exchange where Angus Taylor criticized Labor's proposed capital gains tax reforms. It also notes Ted O’Brien's stance on foreign aid to Pacific countries, distinguishing his view from Pauline Hanson's suggestion regarding aid from China.
summary.zh: 这篇文章报道了安格斯·泰勒批评工党拟议的资本利得税改革的政治交锋。文章还指出特德·奥布莱恩在向太平洋国家提供对外援助问题上的立场，他与宝琳·汉森关于接受中国援助的建议划清了界限。

body.en:
Australia's Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has warned against a leadership change in the United Kingdom amid reports his British Labour counterpart Keir Starmer could be about to resign.

Britain's Observer newspaper is reporting Starmer is expected to resign on Monday and set out a timetable for his departure.

The Observer report, which did not name its sources, said Starmer had reached the conclusion that his position was no longer tenable after speaking to cabinet ministers, advisers, donors and trade union leaders.

However, a government source said Starmer remained focused on getting on with the job of governing.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Asked about the potential change by Sky News on Sunday morning, Albanese said he will "deal with whoever is elected".

"But I must say that the history of just changing leaders is not a positive one," he said. "I've dealt with already four British prime ministers since I've been elected as prime minister."

Speculation of Starmer's retirement has been building for months and has accelerated since Friday, when his rival Andy Burnham won more than 50 per cent of the vote in the Makerfield byelection, officially allowing him to now launch a formal leadership challenge.

Burnham, the 56-year-old mayor of Greater Manchester, is widely seen as Starmer's most likely successor, whether through a negotiated transfer of power or a formal leadership contest.

He used his victory speech to promise a new path for the United Kingdom, rather than launching an immediate formal challenge.

Starmer said on Friday he would fight any challenge to his leadership and urged Labour not to tear itself apart with infighting.

Starmer led the centre-left Labour party to a landslide election win in 2024, but became deeply unpopular after a series of scandals, policy U-turns and local election defeats.

More than 100 elected lawmakers in Starmer's party - roughly a quarter of all Labour representatives in the House of Commons - have publicly said they want him to quit or set out a timetable for his exit, according to a Reuters tally.

If he were to quit or be ousted, it would be the United Kingdom's seventh prime minister in just over a decade — the highest turnover in nearly two centuries.

Albanese has previously backed Starmer's leadership, in May saying: "He is a friend of mine, and I hope that Keir Starmer continues to serve as prime minister of the United Kingdom", and warning that the, "revolving door of leaders does not lead to stability".

body.en:
Lynne Meehan’s 91-year-old dad, John Wilson, was diagnosed with sepsis last September.

That was the start of the family’s frustrating experience with accessing the aged care system.

"I worked in intensive care for 28 years and have never seen anything so complicated or so difficult," Meehan, 57, said.

Last November, the federal government overhauled the way older Australians are assessed for support at home. Called the integrated assessment tool (IAT), it involves an assessor carrying out a lengthy, wide-ranging survey of the person's needs.

They then put their findings into an algorithm, and an outcome is provided automatically, with how much funding support the person gets, and a priority level.

"I had no idea that it all got fed into a machine and a number got spat out," Meehan said.

John Wilson received $58,000 annually in funding on a Level 7 package – the second-highest support level. It was more than the family expected.

The bigger issue, though, was that the algorithm deemed his case a low priority. The family was told he would have to wait 10 months for his support.

"I said, look, Dad, I know you can't fight, but I will fight for you to get this package'.

"Because he was pretty resigned to the fact that he'd be gone before he got anything," Meehan said.

"At almost 92 years of age, 10 months is …. quite possibly a lifetime in my father's case,” she wrote in one letter.

"Dad had no way of holding a phone or able to push the buttons like 000 and know that that had gone through," she told SBS News.

"It's really important that he (was provided with a device with) one button to push that he would know would get him some sort of outside attention if he needed it."

Her parents used their part-pension instead and were out of pocket $2,000 to install a ramp and rent a fall monitor.

"We've always said that we would continue to review and refine the assessment tool," he told SBS News in a statement.

"While we know there’s much more to do here, we’ll continue to listen to the experiences of older Australians so we can get the best outcomes for them."

The government quietly launched a rapid review into the prioritisation mechanism of the IAT, with advice expected to be provided within three months. From June 29, a person will be able to bounce the survey back to the assessor if there is a clear inputting error.

body.en:
Cost relief at the bowser has been extended for another month, although the savings won't be as substantial.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has announced a limited extension of the fuel excise, making petrol and diesel 16 cents per litre cheaper than the full price in July.

The current saving is 32 cents a litre after it was cut three months ago, following the outbreak of war in the Middle East and ensuing strangulation of global oil supplies.

That discount is scheduled to expire on 30 June, by which time it will have cost the federal budget an estimated $2.9 billion in foregone revenue.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Speaking to Sky News on Sunday morning, Albanese said the decision to halve rather than scrap the discount was about giving motorists and businesses some certainty.

"We know that families are still under pressure, and we also know that the impact of this conflict on the other side of the world will have a long economic tail to it," Albanese told Sky News.

"There's still some uncertainty that oil prices come down this week. We want to see that flow through, but it will take some time."

"This will enable some certainty going forward, and for confidence to remain in the system."

"We'll continue to do what we can to shield Australians from the worst impacts of this conflict, including securing additional fuel from our partners."

Albanese said a "step down", rather than a full removal of the excise was the "sensible thing to do".

States and territories — who have effectively funded their share of the scheme by forgoing a GST windfall gain over the last three months— are expected to come on board with the excise extension.

Treasurer Jim Chalmers said he hoped the temporary support would still take some of the sting out of petrol prices and help with the cost of living.

"Despite the welcome and substantial drop in the price of petrol recently, we recognise people are still under pressure," he said.

"This extra month of fuel discount will help Australian motorists and businesses with the cost of living as this support tapers off."

Pressed on whether further extensions were possible should the US-Iran deal collapse, Albanese stopped short of guaranteeing anything.

"We do live in a volatile world, so were there to be a massive global shock again, my government will always respond," he said.

He also pointed to broader cost-of-living measures landing on 1 July, noting "every Australian worker will get a tax cut" as further relief arriving alongside the reduced fuel discount.

title.en: The 'secret sauce' behind the tiny town that's cracked Australia's energy problem

summary.en: This town isn't waiting for the energy transition — it's powering it.

body.en:
